coverage: All 16 regions and the separate Chatham Islands authority, plus 66 other territorial authorities. Whole cross-region districts retain every official regional relationship, without splitting or duplicate populations. 2025 regional geography and 2026 territorial authorities are clipped to full available LINZ land; population retains its 2023 Census basis. Includes the Kermadec and five subantarctic island groups, Tokelau, Cook Islands and Niue (self-governing states in free association), and the labelled Ross Antarctic claim. Named Cook Islands (15 island groups) and Tokelau (three atolls) have land-only local pages and focused entry. These are geographic groups, not fabricated council polygons.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
